identitySignals: The Unity Council's own website names it as a nonprofit based in Oakland's Fruitvale neighborhood, matching the agenda's 'The Unity Council' and 'Oakland, CA'
Its website lists Head Start and Early Head Start programs, matching the agenda item 'The Unity Council Head Start Program' (Early Childhood Education Department)
ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer lists a 501(c)(3) in Oakland, CA, Spanish-speaking Unity Council of Alameda County Inc (EIN 94-1670490); GuideStar lists the same EIN as 'The Unity Council'
research.notes: The agenda names 'The Unity Council Children and Family Services'; this is the Unity Council's Head Start program, run by the same organization. The legal name is the IRS-registered name; the organization does business as The Unity Council. The home page lists a different main number (510-535-6910) than the contact page (510-535-6900); the contact page was used.

profile.legalName: Spanish-speaking Unity Council Of Alameda County Inc
profile.summary: The Unity Council is a nonprofit based in Oakland's Fruitvale neighborhood. It works on affordable housing, career, financial and housing services, small business support, and programs for children, families and seniors, including Head Start and Early Head Start early childhood programs.

sources.title: Spanish-speaking Unity Council Of Alameda County Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: The Unity Council (Fruitvale, Oakland; EIN 94-1670490, 501(c)(3)) runs Head Start and Early Head Start, matching the agenda's Unity Council Head Start Program interagency agreement with OUSD's Early Childhood Education Department. Legal name, EIN, address, phone and email are shown on the cited ProPublica, home and contact pages, and the summary is neutral and supported.
